content.description: Reads the platform's pin set once, then asks every store's own owner to delete what nothing pins: registry identities and blobs (qits-artifacts), host images, orphan volumes and buildkit cache (qits-containers), service clients nothing claims (qits-idp), and mirrored images no manifest pins (qits-mirror). Measures host disk and the registry store before and after.
